Safety Policy for Children
 
Latest updated: December, 2024
 
Ola Party attaches great importance to the protection of children. We strictly abide by the laws and regulations on the protection of minors in the country where our users are located, and strive to provide children with a suitable application experience. Any users violating this policy on protection of children’s safety or other terms/ rules of Ola Party regarding children’s safety will be punished accordingly and may face further consequences including being reported to relevant law enforcement (authorities or agencies).
 
This Policy shall be effective upon publication and will automatically become part of the Terms of the Service between you and Ola Party. All terms used in this Policy shall have the same meaning as those in the Terms of Service unless otherwise specified.
 
    1. General Rule
 
You must be at least 18 years old or the equivalent age as specified by law in your jurisdiction to use Ola Party.
You are prohibited to intentionally provide incorrect age information age, make false representations regarding your age, or using any other method to cheat the APP about your age to get access to the App or Services.
 
    2. Prohibition against Child Endangerment
 
We have enforced both AI technology and manual approaches to detect any child endangerment behavior or content, including:
  • Sharing, creating, or distributing content involving child sexual abuse and sexual exploitation (whether in virtual form or in real life) (collectively referred to as “CSAE”), child nudity, or any other kind of child abuse.
  • Kidnapping or abduction of children and any such information.
  • Content of children engaging in illegal activities, violence, sexual behavior, pornographic, drug use, smoking, shameful or other inappropriate behaviors.
  • Any predatory behavior towards children, such as:
      A. Inappropriate interaction targeted at a child (for example, groping or caressing).
      B. Child grooming (for example, befriending a child online to facilitate, either online or offline, sexual contact and/or exchanging sexual imagery with that child).
      C. Sexualization of a minor (for example, imagery that depicts, encourages or promotes the sexual abuse of children or the portrayal of children in a manner that could result in the sexual exploitation of children).
      D. Sextortion (for example, threatening or blackmailing a child by using real or alleged access to a child’s intimate images).
      E. Trafficking of a child (for example, advertising or solicitation of a child for commercial sexual exploitation).
  • Any behavior or content that may cast negative effect against children or violating local laws and regulations on children protection.
     
    3. Live Broadcasting involving Children
 
Live broadcasting involving children or minors is strictly prohibited. We will conduct strict reviews on live broadcast content, focusing especially on whether minors are involved in the live broadcasts or appear in the live broadcast pictures. Once it is found that minors are participating in live broadcasts without permission, the live broadcasts will be immediately interrupted, and relevant accounts may be blocked or otherwise processed.
 
    4. Reporting Channels
 
We provide users with comprehensive complaint and reporting channels for violations involving children, including:
  • Frontend reporting channels. You can find the tab "Report Child Content" in different occasions, ie. rooms, personal profiles, posts, etc.
  • Customer service feedback channels. In FAQ section of Help Center, answer of the question "What should I do if I find out about child abuse or exploitation?" will guide you to report any suspected child abuse or exploitation behavior in the App.
  • Email reporting. If you find any violation of the above rules or behavior involving child abuse, you may contact us at olachildrenreport@gmail.com and provide the details of the violation.
    5. Punishment Rules
 
All violations of the Child Safety Policy will result in corresponding punishments, including but not limited to removal of the violating content, blocking of the violating account, etc.
 
    6. Reporting Mechanism
 
Despite the above, we will take appropriate action, which may include reporting to the App Store, the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) or any other local law enforcement (agencies or authorities), or child safety organization, if we are aware of violations.
 
    7. Transparency
 
We will regularly update and disclose our child safety policies and practices according to relevant laws and regulations.
 
    8. Child Protection Agency Contact
 
You are also encouraged to contact your local authority or organization if you come across child abuse behaviors. We have listed some contacts below for your quick reference.
